name: Electricity
description: Create Crafts & Additions adds Forge Energy (FE) to Create.

pages.title: Electricity
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() An **Alternator** makes FE from rotation, 32 RPM and up
- Wire **connectors** together: **Pull** on producers, **Push** on consumers
- **Copper Spool**: low current. **Gold** and **Electrum**: high current, for the Large Connector
- Store FE in the multiblock **Accumulator**

Create Crafts & Additions adds Forge Energy (FE) to Create. You generate FE from [#](2E5AAC)[rotation](entry://create_basics/rotation)[#](), carry it on wires between connectors, and spend it in motors, pumps and chargers. Compare it with rotation in [#](2E5AAC)[Rotation vs Electricity](entry://industry/power_compared)[#]().

pages.title: Alternator
pages.text: Turns rotation into FE, from 32 [#](7A3C9A)[RPM](entry://glossary/rpm)[#]() up. Faster spin makes more. Place a connector on it and set the connector to Pull.

pages.title: Small Connector
pages.text: Links FE blocks with wire. [#](2E5AAC)[Wrench](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() cycles Push, Pull and None. Up to 4 wires.

Connector modes:
- **Pull** takes FE out of the block it is attached to (producers).
- **Push** feeds FE into it (consumers).
- **None** only relays between wires, so it can sit on any block.

pages.title: Wire spools
pages.text: Right-click two connectors with a filled spool to wire them. An Empty Spool on both ends removes the wire and gives the spool back.

Two current grades:
- **Copper Spool**: low current, fits Small Connectors.
- **Gold** and **Electrum** spools: high current. The Large Connector needs those, takes up to 6 wires and carries more.

pages.title: Large Connector
pages.text: High-current connector. Needs a Gold or Electrum spool. Good for trunk lines between generators and storage.

pages.title: Accumulator
pages.text: A [#](7A3C9A)[multiblock](entry://glossary/multiblock)[#]() battery: configure one input connector and one output. It also pushes FE into blocks on its top and bottom faces.

pages.title: Tesla Coil
pages.text: Charges FE items placed under it. With a redstone signal it zaps nearby mobs and players. Some charging recipes make new items: check [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]().

pages.title: Rolling Mill
pages.text: Takes rotation and rolls ingots and plates into rods and wires. Automate with a belt and two funnels.

Rods and wires feed the spools, motors and connectors. Electrum (a Crafts & Additions alloy) is needed for high current gear; look up its recipe in JEI. **Barbed Wire** hurts anything that walks through.

- The **Servo Motor** turns attached blocks to an exact angle from redstone and needs FE.
- The **Electric Pump** is a FE-powered fluid pump.

Burning fuel without rotation: see [#](2E5AAC)[Burning Liquid Fuel](entry://industry/liquid_fuel)[#]().

pages.title: Shared with TFMG
pages.text: [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** TFMG uses Crafts & Additions' **Copper Wire**: its recipes take it, and leftover TFMG copper wire converts 1:1 in a crafting grid. TFMG keeps its own **Copper Spool**, since only TFMG spools fit its Winding Machine and lay TFMG cable. See [#](2E5AAC)[Shared Metals](entry://materials/shared_metals)[#]().

This version of Crafts & Additions has only the multiblock Accumulator; the older single-block one was removed.\
\
To carry FE storage on a moving contraption, the [Portable Energy Interface](item://createaddition:portable_energy_interface) swaps FE with a stationary one as it passes.
